_about: Russ's answers to sync questions. sync:check reads this on every run. Events and posts are keyed by their .com id. Event fields: ignore (reason; the event is never raised or imported again), trainer (coach-profiles id), trainerName (display name when there is no profile), course (training-courses id), note. Post fields: ignore (reason), author (coach-profiles id), webinar ('writeup' or 'announcement', settling the webinar rule for that post), note. organizers maps a .com organizer name to the trainer it stands for: a coach-profiles id, a display name, or an empty string for 'no trainer shown'.
